title: A roadmap step file uses only the field names build.py knows
why: Triage 22:05 CST Nov 8: four step files carried `updated` in place of `updatedAt` after triage's own inline edits, so the page lost their change times. Nothing refused the unknown key.
note: Proposed check: roadmap/build.py refuses (exit non-zero) a step file with a key outside its known set (title, why, note, phase, owner, lane, status, order, updatedAt, ask, paused, grants, blockedBy, home, due). Red case first: a step file with `updated`.
